description: Terminal-verifier decorrelation row trained against probe_iid_mean: the IID probe v2 with the mean-pooled readout (terminal_prerl_v2, with reasoning: the count-weighted mean of the reader's activations over the episode's thinking and text; data/probes/Inkling-Small/v2/README.md), a frozen probe on the full-precision Inkling-Small reader (thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small@8cc5877b44d343f88b92086aa1fb72897950f06a), scored live by experiments/inkling_probe_server.py at server_url (http://127.0.0.1:8178, reached from the RL machine through an SSH tunnel; one server serves both mean-pooled probes). docs/inkling_probes_amendment_4.md fixes this row. Reward = submission verdict - penalty_coef x the probe's score in the reward as the monitor defines it (monitors/inkling_probe_monitor.py). Held out, scored at every eval and never in the gradient: the four local Qwen judges, spec for spec as in terminal_verifier_probe_iid.json. The other v2 probes with reasoning (probe_iid, probe_ood, probe_ood_mean) are held out too but scored after the run from eval_rollouts.jsonl (experiments/eval_inkling_probes_on_runs.py), not live, so they are not listed here. Every other field equals terminal_verifier_probe_iid.json (amendment 3's IID row: terminal_verifier_q3_cot.json with stop_after_zero_behavior_steps null and save_every 9, as its description says).
